overview_description.description: Lightwell is a provide society with the latest Smart City developments in the field of lighting. Our team of engineers & industrial designers are ready to integrate the latest innovations in this field into our products . We regard public lighting as the foundation for making a city 'Smart Ready'. Partly because of this, we work closely together with partners such as Luminext, Signify Interact City & Tvilight. For example, almost all of our luminaires are now Zhaga Ready and we have successfully been the first to develop a fixture that can charge an electric car and also provide access to Wi-Fi and more.
